question: Can a fixed non-expansive monotone fraction map remove CB30/CB31 high-frequency amplification while retaining useful AO6-distribution style on the consumed gold/stress development cohort?

population.input_rail: legacy hash-bound encoded-sRGB JPEG display proxies; not RAW or scene-linear evidence

operator.knot_selection: uniform deterministic indices over exact unique sorted valid base fractions, including both endpoints
operator.raw_targets: AO6 empirical fraction quantiles evaluated at each base knot grouped-midrank
operator.slope_projection: clip every nonnegative raw target increment to maximum_fraction_slope times its base-knot increment
operator.vertical_anchor: single least-squares constant offset from the clipped cumulative increments to raw knot targets, clipped only to keep all knots in [0,1]
operator.interpolation: piecewise linear with constant endpoint extension
operator.equal_input_invariant: exactly equal valid base fractions map to exactly equal target fractions
operator.reconstruction: unchanged rotated hue and mapped fraction at exact CB11 luminance
operator.safe_executor: unchanged analytical source-boundary and float32-margin step
operator.forbidden: gold-tuned slope, adaptive knot count, cubic overshoot, local map, semantic mask, derivative rescue or post-score tuning

research_basis.classical_basis: one-dimensional monotone transport with a 1-Lipschitz envelope is non-expansive in normalized gamut-fraction distance
research_basis.position: clean-room deterministic bounded explicit baseline; no paper code, model, weights or novelty claim

stop_rules: Any non-expansive invariant or automatic failure closes this exact 257-knot mechanism before visual review.
Do not tune slope, knot count, anchor or interpolation on the consumed cohort.
A development pass requires a separately frozen source-disjoint automatic and severe confirmation before any research-champion reconsideration.
claim_ceiling: Development-only non-expansive explicit fraction-transport evidence on the already consumed 40-row frozen cohort; not independent confirmation, complete face closure, stock response, calibration, population preference or product promotion.
